unavailable_or_unclassified: Completed P1 original-source mathematical construction with actual acquired scoped internal audits in the distinct matching ZIP. The older denied archive was not retried. Arbitrary programmable scalar LINEAR measurements are a stronger access contract than the previous coordinate interface. Exact quadratic/known Gaussian and stated noise assumptions are substantive. k+1 versus k is an additive-budget comparison, not a same-budget optimizer. Hard exact-query classification does not classify expected exact counts; noisy optimal-fixed statement needs unit rows and0 < s <= 1. Root-MSE transfer has2tau outside square roots, not MSE+2tau. Dense controls, model/prior/noise acquisition, precision, source preparation and full ordinary alternatives remain paid. Jackowski1991 overlap is UNKNOWN; public403/no acquired body is neither novelty evidence nor an acceptance gate. No new science replay, audit/sign-off or practical/device advantage.
